hints.title: Reachability Property
hints.text: Determine the maximum path length to each index based on preceding reachable positions.

hints.title: Subproblem Array
hints.text: Maintain an array tracking the maximum jumps to reach each index from index 0.

hints.title: Forward Transitions
hints.text: For each reachable index i, check each j > i where the absolute difference is within target, updating dp[j].

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 1D dynamic programming updating maximum jump lengths from index 0.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive backtracking without memoization explores exponentially many paths across dense edges.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n^2) time over index pairs and O(n) auxiliary space for states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Initialize unreachable states to -1 and advance only from reachable indices.
